method: Playwright 1.56.1 WebKit 26.0, iPhone 13 mobile/touch context. Native WebKit Input.dispatchTouchEvent produces trusted touch PointerEvents. Deterministic game time uses __game.step; game state is never directly changed.

checks.name: WK-NAV: six thumbnails decode; trusted touch opens every mode with no input leak
WK-G01: native touch tap scores and 30-second result replays
WK-G02: native touch swipe during jump moves the box and scores
WK-G03: native touch hold/release succeeds; held-through punch fails
WK-G04: native tap puts on hat and ignores taps while worn
WK-G05: native touch drags both cheeks; release and reset restore face
WK-G06: native touch moves feather; release keeps pursuit; capture retries
WK-LIFE: pause freezes; resume and menu touches do not leak
WK-LAYOUT: iPhone viewport and landscape preserve stage and 44px navigation
WK-CONSOLE: no uncaught JS, console or local asset HTTP errors

limitations: This is Linux WebKit with an iPhone viewport/user agent, not a physical iPhone or shipping iOS Safari. Physical-device certification remains outstanding.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 15_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/26.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1

sourceVerification.method: The same frozen preview index was fetched after the native touch suite; the original native harness does not assert the entry hash itself.
